messages:
marta: Quick sync: GA checklist for Predictor-v2 — we need final SLA wording, monitoring runbooks, a short customer-facing incident blurb, oncall bindings, and pricing tier text. Can owners for each commit by EOD tomorrow?

lucas: I can do SLA + fallback policy wording. Proposal: public SLOs are p95 latency and an internal p99; include clear rollback triggers. Will drop draft.

anya: I'll own monitoring + runbooks. Proposed quick alerts: latency_p95 > 200ms (P2), error_rate > 0.5% (P1). Will publish dashboard and short playbook.

phil: Docs + customer blurb + SDK upgrade note. Will keep examples minimal and include migration note for quantization default.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary window scheduled 2026-05-15 04:00 UTC.

marta: Commercial asks: lucas, include note about reserved vs burst pricing so pricing can draft tiers.

lucas: Will add SLA appendix with autoscale example and a sentence about reserved capacity guarantees.

anya: Need oncall emails for new route. @marta can you confirm escalation targets (infra vs billing)?

marta: Yes — infra: infra-oncall@redwood, billing: billing-ops@redwood. Also legal needs a one-line refund cap for the billing playbook.

phil: Ok will add a one-line "what to tell customers" and link to the shiproom doc.

marta: Action list: Lucas SLA, Anya monitoring/runbooks, Phil docs/customer blurb, Pricing to draft tiers (chefs). Due EOD tomorrow. Ping if blocked.

lucas: Draft SLA link: /docs/drafts/predictor-v2-sla-short.md

anya: Dashboard id: 4333 pushed to grafana/predictor-v2. I'll run quick smoke pre-canary and post results here.

marta: Great. I'll consolidate into the shiproom morning brief. :rocket:
